<h3>Field Detail</h3>
<a id="optimizationMode">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>optimizationMode</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">OptimizationMode</a> optimizationMode</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The optimization mode to be used for route calculation. By default, it is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode#FASTEST"><code>OptimizationMode.FASTEST</code></a>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="alternatives">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>alternatives</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;int alternatives</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Maximum number of alternative routes that will be calculated, in addition
 to the best one. The provided value must be in the range [0, 6].
 Alternative routes can be unavailable, thus they are not guaranteed to be returned.
 The order of routes is from the best to the worst, as evaluated by the route calculation
 algorithm and according to the given input parameters.
 Defaults to 0, which means there are no alternatives, i.e. only the best route is returned.
 Must be 0 for isoline calculation.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="departureTime">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>departureTime</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.util.Date departureTime</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Optional time when travel is expected to start. Traffic speed and
 incidents shall be taken into account in the calculation of the route, per <a href="#trafficOptimizationMode"><code>trafficOptimizationMode</code></a>.
 By default, the time is not set.
 If the time is not set, the current time will be used internally, i.e. now.
 Therefore, by default, a time-aware route request is initiated including traffic.
 <p><strong>Note</strong>:
 <ul>
 <li>Both departure time and <a href="#arrivalTime"><code>arrivalTime</code></a> cannot be set at the same time.</li>
 <li>This parameter is handled as local time. Therefore, it is necessary to specify the time zone offset
 when setting the time in areas with different time zones, i.e. 2025-02-04T08:00:00+07:00</li>
 </ul></div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="arrivalTime">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>arrivalTime</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.util.Date arrivalTime</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Optional time when travel is expected to end. Traffic speed and
 incidents shall be taken into account in the calculation of the route, per <a href="#trafficOptimizationMode"><code>trafficOptimizationMode</code></a>.
 By default, the time is not set.
 If the time is not set, the current time will be used internally, to predict the arrival time.
 Therefore, by default, a time-aware route request is initiated including traffic.
 <p><strong>Note</strong>:
 <ul>
 <li>Both <a href="#departureTime"><code>departureTime</code></a> and arrival time cannot be set at the same time.</li>
 <li>This parameter is handled as local time. Therefore, it is necessary to specify the time zone offset
 when setting the time in areas with different time zones, i.e. 2025-02-04T08:00:00+07:00</li>
 </ul></div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="speedCapInMetersPerSecond">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>speedCapInMetersPerSecond</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.Double speedCapInMetersPerSecond</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies the maximum speed in meters per second, which the user wishes not to exceed.
 The valid range is [1, 70] meters per second. Note that it is valid only for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-transportmode#CAR"><code>TransportMode.CAR</code></a>,
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-transportmode#TRUCK"><code>TransportMode.TRUCK</code></a> and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-transportmode#SCOOTER"><code>TransportMode.SCOOTER</code></a> transport modes.
 For car, truck and scooter transport modes, it will affect <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-route#getDuration()"><code>Route.getDuration()</code></a> of
 the route. Only for scooter transport mode, it may affect the route geometry. Defaults to <code>null</code>,
 which means that no speed cap is set.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="enableRouteHandle">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>enableRouteHandle</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;boolean enableRouteHandle</pre>
<div class="block"><p>A flag that indicates whether the resulting route should contain a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routehandle" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>RouteHandle</code></a>.
 Defaults to <code>false</code>.
 Note that a <code>RouteHandle</code> generated by the online <code>RoutingEngine</code> is not compatible with the <code>OfflineRoutingEngine</code> and vice versa.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="trafficOptimizationMode">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>trafficOptimizationMode</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficoptimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">TrafficOptimizationMode</a> trafficOptimizationMode</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The traffic optimization mode to be used for route calculation. By default, it is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficoptimizationmode#TIME_DEPENDENT"><code>TrafficOptimizationMode.TIME_DEPENDENT</code></a>, which enables traffic-aware routing.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="enableTolls">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>enableTolls</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;boolean enableTolls</pre>
<div class="block"><p>A flag that indicates whether the resulting route <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-section#getTolls()"><code>Section.getTolls()</code></a> properties should contain
 tolls data. Defaults to <code>false</code>.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> When a route calculation request asks tolls, a pricing scheme with higher rates might be applied.
 Consult your HERE representative to get more information on the related pricing schemes.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> For users of the <code>OfflineRoutingEngine</code> this is a beta release of this feature,
 so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors. The <code>OfflineRoutingEngine</code> is available for
 editions such as the <em>Navigate Edition</em>. For users of the <code>RoutingEngine</code> the feature is stable.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="optimizeWaypointsOrder">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>optimizeWaypointsOrder</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;boolean optimizeWaypointsOrder</pre>
<div class="block"><p>A flag that indicates whether the order of waypoints that is passed to <code>calculateRoute()</code> should be optimized in the best order.
 The best order is calculated by the same metrics that are used during regular calculation, e.g. <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>OptimizationMode</code></a>.
 The starting and destination <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-waypoint" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>Waypoint</code></a> are not reordered.
 If the whole number of waypoints is fewer than 4 - the flag doesn't affect the resulting route (nothing to optimize).
 The resulting order of waypoints can be identified by their waypoint indices in the route sections
 (see <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-route#getSections()"><code>Route.getSections()</code></a>, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-section#getDeparturePlace()"><code>Section.getDeparturePlace()</code></a>, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-section#getArrivalPlace()"><code>Section.getArrivalPlace()</code></a>, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeplace#waypointIndex"><code>RoutePlace.waypointIndex</code></a>).
 Currently, the waypoints order optimization is available only when using the <code>OfflineRoutingEngine</code> (not available for all editions).
 Defaults to <code>false</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="enableRouteLabels">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>enableRouteLabels</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;boolean enableRouteLabels</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies whether route labels should be included in the route response.
 Route labels identify major highways or road names along the route.
 By default, this is set to <code>false</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>

<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>optimizationMode</code> - <p>The optimization mode to be used for route calculation. By default, it is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode#FASTEST"><code>OptimizationMode.FASTEST</code></a>.</dd>

<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>RouteOptions</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;RouteOptions&#8203;(@NonNull
                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">OptimizationMode</a>&nbsp;optimizationMode,
                    int&nbsp;alternatives)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a new instance.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>optimizationMode</code> - <p>The optimization mode to be used for route calculation. By default, it is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode#FASTEST"><code>OptimizationMode.FASTEST</code></a>.</dd>
<dd><code>alternatives</code> - <p>Maximum number of alternative routes that will be calculated, in addition
 to the best one. The provided value must be in the range [0, 6].
 Alternative routes can be unavailable, thus they are not guaranteed to be returned.
 The order of routes is from the best to the worst, as evaluated by the route calculation
 algorithm and according to the given input parameters.
 Defaults to 0, which means there are no alternatives, i.e. only the best route is returned.
 Must be 0 for isoline calculation.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<pre>public&nbsp;RouteOptions&#8203;(@NonNull
                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">OptimizationMode</a>&nbsp;optimizationMode,
                    int&nbsp;alternatives,
                    @Nullable
                    java.util.Date&nbsp;departureTime)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a new instance.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>optimizationMode</code> - <p>The optimization mode to be used for route calculation. By default, it is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode#FASTEST"><code>OptimizationMode.FASTEST</code></a>.</dd>
<dd><code>alternatives</code> - <p>Maximum number of alternative routes that will be calculated, in addition
 to the best one. The provided value must be in the range [0, 6].
 Alternative routes can be unavailable, thus they are not guaranteed to be returned.
 The order of routes is from the best to the worst, as evaluated by the route calculation
 algorithm and according to the given input parameters.
 Defaults to 0, which means there are no alternatives, i.e. only the best route is returned.
 Must be 0 for isoline calculation.</dd>
<dd><code>departureTime</code> - <p>Optional time when travel is expected to start. Traffic speed and
 incidents shall be taken into account in the calculation of the route, per <a href="#trafficOptimizationMode"><code>trafficOptimizationMode</code></a>.
 By default, the time is not set.
 If the time is not set, the current time will be used internally, i.e. now.
 Therefore, by default, a time-aware route request is initiated including traffic.
 <p><strong>Note</strong>:
 <ul>
 <li>Both departure time and <a href="#arrivalTime"><code>arrivalTime</code></a> cannot be set at the same time.</li>
 <li>This parameter is handled as local time. Therefore, it is necessary to specify the time zone offset
 when setting the time in areas with different time zones, i.e. 2025-02-04T08:00:00+07:00</li>
 </ul></dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

                    java.lang.Double&nbsp;speedCapInMetersPerSecond,
                    boolean&nbsp;enableRouteHandle,
                    @NonNull
                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficoptimizationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">TrafficOptimizationMode</a>&nbsp;trafficOptimizationMode,
                    boolean&nbsp;enableTolls)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a new instance.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>optimizationMode</code> - <p>The optimization mode to be used for route calculation. By default, it is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-optimizationmode#FASTEST"><code>OptimizationMode.FASTEST</code></a>.</dd>
<dd><code>alternatives</code> - <p>Maximum number of alternative routes that will be calculated, in addition
 to the best one. The provided value must be in the range [0, 6].
 Alternative routes can be unavailable, thus they are not guaranteed to be returned.
 The order of routes is from the best to the worst, as evaluated by the route calculation
 algorithm and according to the given input parameters.
 Defaults to 0, which means there are no alternatives, i.e. only the best route is returned.
 Must be 0 for isoline calculation.</dd>
<dd><code>departureTime</code> - <p>Optional time when travel is expected to start. Traffic speed and
 incidents shall be taken into account in the calculation of the route, per <a href="#trafficOptimizationMode"><code>trafficOptimizationMode</code></a>.
 By default, the time is not set.
 If the time is not set, the current time will be used internally, i.e. now.
 Therefore, by default, a time-aware route request is initiated including traffic.
 <p><strong>Note</strong>:
 <ul>
 <li>Both departure time and <a href="#arrivalTime"><code>arrivalTime</code></a> cannot be set at the same time.</li>
 <li>This parameter is handled as local time. Therefore, it is necessary to specify the time zone offset
 when setting the time in areas with different time zones, i.e. 2025-02-04T08:00:00+07:00</li>
 </ul></dd>
<dd><code>arrivalTime</code> - <p>Optional time when travel is expected to end. Traffic speed and
 incidents shall be taken into account in the calculation of the route, per <a href="#trafficOptimizationMode"><code>trafficOptimizationMode</code></a>.
 By default, the time is not set.
 If the time is not set, the current time will be used internally, to predict the arrival time.
 Therefore, by default, a time-aware route request is initiated including traffic.
 <p><strong>Note</strong>:
 <ul>
 <li>Both <a href="#departureTime"><code>departureTime</code></a> and arrival time cannot be set at the same time.</li>
 <li>This parameter is handled as local time. Therefore, it is necessary to specify the time zone offset
 when setting the time in areas with different time zones, i.e. 2025-02-04T08:00:00+07:00</li>
 </ul></dd>
<dd><code>speedCapInMetersPerSecond</code> - <p>Specifies the maximum speed in meters per second, which the user wishes not to exceed.
 The valid range is [1, 70] meters per second. Note that it is valid only for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-transportmode#CAR"><code>TransportMode.CAR</code></a>,
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-transportmode#TRUCK"><code>TransportMode.TRUCK</code></a> and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-transportmode#SCOOTER"><code>TransportMode.SCOOTER</code></a> transport modes.
 For car, truck and scooter transport modes, it will affect <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-route#getDuration()"><code>Route.getDuration()</code></a> of
 the route. Only for scooter transport mode, it may affect the route geometry. Defaults to <code>null</code>,
 which means that no speed cap is set.</dd>
<dd><code>enableRouteHandle</code> - <p>A flag that indicates whether the resulting route should contain a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routehandle" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>RouteHandle</code></a>.
 Defaults to <code>false</code>.
 Note that a <code>RouteHandle</code> generated by the online <code>RoutingEngine</code> is not compatible with the <code>OfflineRoutingEngine</code> and vice versa.</dd>
<dd><code>trafficOptimizationMode</code> - <p>The traffic optimization mode to be used for route calculation. By default, it is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficoptimizationmode#TIME_DEPENDENT"><code>TrafficOptimizationMode.TIME_DEPENDENT</code></a>, which enables traffic-aware routing.</dd>
<dd><code>enableTolls</code> - <p>A flag that indicates whether the resulting route <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-section#getTolls()"><code>Section.getTolls()</code></a> properties should contain
 tolls data. Defaults to <code>false</code>.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> When a route calculation request asks tolls, a pricing scheme with higher rates might be applied.
 Consult your HERE representative to get more information on the related pricing schemes.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> For users of the <code>OfflineRoutingEngine</code> this is a beta release of this feature,
 so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors. The <code>OfflineRoutingEngine</code> is available for
 editions such as the <em>Navigate Edition</em>. For users of the <code>RoutingEngine</code> the feature is stable.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
